chunks: Turn towards Him and be dutiful to Him; be firm in devotion, and do not become an idolater,

key_terms.اتَّقُوهُ: Be dutiful to God / Have God-consciousness
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكِينَ: Idolaters / Those who associate partners with God
key_terms.مُنِيبِينَ: Turning back or returning towards God

ai.seo_question: What are the key actions believers are commanded to perform in this verse from Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ar-Rum, this verse serves as the spiritual remedy to the societal corruption described in preceding verses, urging a holistic return (tawbah) to the Divine. Shia scholarship highlights the triad of 'turning to God,' 'God-consciousness,' and 'establishing prayer' as the foundation of both individual piety and communal stability, with 'establishing' (iqamah) implying constancy and perfection in worship. This commandment underscores that true monotheism (tawhid) is not merely theological but is manifested through consistent ritual practice and mindfulness of God.
